issues.problem: A genitive cannot attach to the first member of the compound, so 'wives of others' (Hindi दूसरों की पत्नियों के वेश) joins pareṣām to the compound against the grammar; the adjacent reading pareṣām māṇavaiḥ ('with the young men of others') is at least as natural. Left as drafted because the sense is unclear.
issues.fix: Add a note; person to decide.

patch.text: Reviewer: pareṣām cannot grammatically qualify the first member of the compound bhāryā-vyañjanāḥ; the adjacent reading 'with the young men of others' (pareṣām māṇavaiḥ), or bhāryā-vyañjanāḥ as nominative subject, is at least as natural as the draft. Rendering left literal; a person should decide.

issues.problem: Gender: the compound ends in neuter ādhāna, so n., not m.
Glossary (4.1): ādhāna = pledge (बन्धक); the draft left आधान and English says 'pledging'.
'of these' read as partitive is doubtful; by the parallel of darśayet + genitive of the recipient in unit 13 (paura-jānapadānām), eṣām may be 'to these'. Literal English kept.
issues.fix: Add a note; person to decide.

patch.text: Reviewer: eṣām may instead be a genitive of the recipient ('point him out to these'), as paura-jānapadānām after darśayet in unit 13; who 'these' are is not stated. Literal rendering kept; a person should decide.

issues.problem: gūḍha is an adjective of bala, so the compound is karmadhāraya, not tat-puruṣa.
Gender n. is asserted for a word whose sense is unknown (kept untranslated).
